children: French Junior Minister for Fisheries Catherine Chabaud said on Thursday that fishermen protesting over high energy prices have agreed to lift blockades of ports in southern France after six hours of talks with the minister.
Chabaud announced notably that fishermen with cash flow issues would be granted zero-interest loans and that fuel support measures would to be tied to changes in fuel prices.
